description: Evaluation set for the multimodal RAG system. Every question has one expected file and the page(s) that contain the answer. type = where the answer lives: text, table, figure or ocr (scanned page).

questions.question: At what pressure are the HydroFlow pumps tested at the factory?
questions.expected_answer: At 24 bar, which is 1.5 times the maximum working pressure of 16 bar.

questions.question: How long is the warranty on HF series pumps?
questions.expected_answer: 24 months from commissioning or 30 months from delivery, whichever comes first.

questions.question: What is the maximum flow rate of the HF-200 pump?
How much does the HF-300 weigh?
What is the motor power of the HF-100?
How much free space must be left around the pump for service?
questions.expected_answer: At least 0.5 m on all sides.

questions.question: What is the maximum allowed shaft misalignment after installation?
What does the HF-200 performance curve show?
questions.expected_answer: Head versus flow rate at 2900 rpm: the head falls from about 45 m at zero flow to about 21 m at 25 m3/h.

questions.question: Where is the best efficiency point of the HF-200?
How often should the motor bearings be lubricated?
When should the mechanical seal be replaced?
questions.expected_answer: Every 16,000 hours or when it is leaking.

questions.question: What should I do if the pump does not deliver water?
questions.expected_answer: Prime it: fill the pump casing and suction pipe with liquid.

questions.question: What can cause excessive vibration of the pump?
questions.expected_answer: An impeller out of balance or cavitation.

questions.question: By how much did Northwind's revenue grow in 2024?
What dividend does the Board propose for 2024?
questions.expected_answer: 1.20 euros per share, up from 1.05 euros.

questions.question: Who is the CEO of Northwind Systems?
What was Northwind's net income in 2024?
What were the earnings per share in 2023?
What does Figure 2 of the annual report show?
questions.expected_answer: Revenue by business segment (Cloud, Hardware, Services) for 2023 and 2024 in EUR million.

questions.question: Which business segment had the highest revenue in 2024?
questions.expected_answer: Cloud, with 232 million euros (48% of revenue).

questions.question: How fast did revenue grow in Asia-Pacific?
What was Northwind's revenue in North America in 2024?
What revenue does Northwind expect for 2025?
Where will Northwind build its new data centres?
Which battery chemistries does the whitepaper compare?
questions.expected_answer: Lithium iron phosphate (LFP), nickel manganese cobalt (NMC) and sodium-ion.

questions.question: At what temperature were the battery cells cycled?
How was end of life defined in the battery study?
questions.expected_answer: When a cell retains 80% of its initial capacity.

questions.question: What does the capacity retention chart show?
questions.expected_answer: Capacity retained versus cycle number: after 3,000 cycles LFP keeps 92%, sodium-ion 86% and NMC 81%.

questions.question: What is the energy density of NMC cells?
Which battery chemistry has the lowest cell cost?
What do the authors recommend for new 4-hour storage systems?
questions.expected_answer: LFP, and to re-evaluate sodium-ion in 2027.
